crates.name: incular
crates.owner: Feature-controlled public facade and application preludes.
crates.support: Re-exports inherit original API classes; platform features are target-specific.

crates.name: incular-accessibility
crates.owner: AccessKit and mobile semantic projections and action translation.
crates.support: Available projections; host integration is platform-specific.

crates.name: incular-android
crates.owner: Android semantic adapter for a native host.
crates.support: Partial; activity, input, surface and system UI require host wiring.

crates.name: incular-animation
crates.owner: Curves, interpolation, tweens and animation physics.
crates.support: Available; interruption contracts consolidate in G.

crates.name: incular-assets
crates.owner: Font identities and shared font bytes.
crates.support: Partial resource foundation; no general image/font/shader loader.

crates.name: incular-config
crates.owner: Shared constraints, alignment, insets, localization and application policies.
crates.support: Available; writable invariant fields migrate in G.

crates.name: incular-controls
crates.owner: Themed Incular controls and visual slots over neutral widgets.
crates.support: Available themed controls; shared behavior consolidates in F.

crates.name: incular-core
crates.owner: Geometry, identity, input, interpolation and lower-level context values.
crates.support: Available; shared dependency sources and scoped subscriptions.

crates.name: incular-desktop
crates.owner: Shared Winit host, WGPU frame coordination and native service integration.
crates.support: Desktop host; one application event loop for both entry APIs.

crates.name: incular-devtools
crates.owner: Opt-in diagnostics transport and runtime command bridge.
crates.support: Implementation integration; not application widget vocabulary.

crates.name: incular-devtools-protocol
crates.owner: Versioned diagnostics messages shared with tooling.
crates.support: Opt-in tooling protocol; no runtime dependency.

crates.name: incular-gestures
crates.owner: Pointer recognition, gesture arbitration, keyboard and focus mechanisms.
crates.support: Available; shared observation contracts consolidate in C/G.

crates.name: incular-image
crates.owner: Raster image identities, decoding and CPU image caches.
crates.support: Available; CPU cache budgets, eviction, and release are implemented. Shared GPU eviction stays in W2.

crates.name: incular-ios
crates.owner: iOS semantic adapter for a native host.
crates.support: Partial; UIKit lifecycle, input and surface require host wiring.

crates.name: incular-layout
crates.owner: Layout algorithms over measured sizes; config values are exact re-exports.
crates.support: Available; retained measurement belongs to widgets.

crates.name: incular-linux
crates.owner: Linux desktop entry and native services over the shared desktop host.
crates.support: Desktop adapter; Linux runtime behavior requires Linux validation.

crates.name: incular-macos
crates.owner: macOS desktop entry and native services over the shared desktop host.
crates.support: Desktop adapter; macOS runtime behavior requires macOS validation.

crates.name: incular-macros
crates.owner: Procedural macros for framework composition and builders.
crates.support: Available; generated APIs inherit the owning type contract.

crates.name: incular-material
crates.owner: Material presentation composed from controls and neutral widgets.
crates.support: Curated subset; parity manifests record omissions.

crates.name: incular-navigation
crates.owner: Application route stacks, routing, restoration and route composition.
crates.support: Available; duplicated widget navigation state consolidates in G.

crates.name: incular-painting
crates.owner: Pure compatibility re-export of incular-rendering.
crates.support: Transition shim; removal condition B08 / Stage J.

crates.name: incular-platform
crates.owner: Portable native IDs, events, capabilities, commands, metrics and errors.
crates.support: Portable contracts; Winit conversion and raw access belong to desktop.

crates.name: incular-rendering
crates.owner: Renderer-neutral commands, paths, canvas and retained compositor layers.
crates.support: Available; backend resources belong to WGPU.

crates.name: incular-runtime
crates.owner: Application lifecycle, scheduling, reactive dispatch, tasks and frame coordination.
crates.support: Available; shared reactive engine and native request lifecycle infrastructure.

crates.name: incular-scroll
crates.owner: Scroll controllers, physics, metrics, extent indexing and geometry.
crates.support: Available; lifecycle and interruption contracts consolidate in G.

crates.name: incular-semantics
crates.owner: Platform-neutral semantic nodes, roles, labels, state and actions.
crates.support: Available; screen-reader projection belongs to accessibility.

crates.name: incular-text
crates.owner: Font selection, shaping, metrics, text layout and editing values.
crates.support: Available; controller observation consolidates in C/G.

crates.name: incular-wgpu
crates.owner: Owned native surfaces, GPU resources and execution of rendering commands.
crates.support: Available WGPU backend; shared reclamation and device recovery improve in H.

crates.name: incular-widgets
crates.owner: Neutral widget composition and retained build/layout/paint/input/semantics.
crates.support: Curated behavior; internal bridge is not an application API.

crates.name: incular-windows
crates.owner: Windows desktop entry and native services over the shared desktop host.
crates.support: Desktop adapter; Stage A native lifecycle validated on Windows.
